ITEM 1 | Orange, glossy, cooked pieces with a slightly translucent surface and a soft, smooth texture. Mostly lengthwise halves and diagonal slices, about 4-6 cm long and 1.5-2.5 cm thick, with a few small rounds. Some pieces show light caramelized edges. They are scattered across the left half of a pale aqua plate, with no sauce visible. | 110

ITEM 2 | Pale ivory-white florets with a matte, slightly bumpy surface and no browning. Clusters of about 8-10 florets, each roughly 2-4 cm across on short, firm pale stems. They sit on the right side of the plate, with one loose floret near the lower edge. No sauce, oil, or seasoning is visible. | 85
